status: UNADOPTED AUTHORING PROPOSAL; UNSENT; 25 remaining General exploration feats

sharedProposal.scope: Together with the separate six training-feat proposals, these entries cover all31 original GE questions. Every source object and question remains preserved separately. The25 Skill-feat proposals are a different cohort. None changes the eight reviewed operational feats or any submitted expedition file.
sharedProposal.ownership: NEW: each feat is nonrepeatable, requires a real permitted feat selection, and checks its printed permanent ability/feat/total-level prerequisites at acquisition. A printed prerequisite feat means its exact source ID, not a similarly named card. Temporary loss does not revoke ownership. No general respec or additional selection is created. For a fixed skill grant without an explicit Expertise clause, an existing proficiency gains no extra proficiency or Expertise from this feat; this duplicate policy is NEW and needs the joint feat conference's decision.
sharedProposal.rollsAndResources: Keep Core task degrees, natural shifts, opposed ties, binary saves, one PB contribution, strongest applicable Expertise, and ordinary advantage/disadvantage cancellation. Physical actors, real inventory, elapsed time, actual work/rest and movement ledgers still apply. An information task does not create the evidence it purports to examine. Absolute source promises are expressly interpreted below rather than silently discarded.
sharedProposal.timeAndWorld: All new work times, DCs, caps and exceptional senses below are proposed authoring choices. The live58-question expedition/social/transport conference controls the next revision of baseline pace, Supply units, forage/depletion, participant budgets, hires, prices and social procedure. A feat modifies an actual task or route; it does not define another calendar or parallel world clock. Literal direction/deadline receipts do not authorize cosmology interpretation.
sharedProposal.audienceAndAgency: A check only occurs for an actually possible uncertain request. Announce the concrete success result and cost before the roll. Preserve understood communication, actual contacts, NPC willingness and the distinction between genuine agreement and magical restrictions. No ordinary successful social check changes player beliefs or commands an impossible action. An explicit feat exception such as Deceiver's truth-compulsion clause is assessed on its own exact terms.
sharedProposal.provenance: NEW details and source limitations are individually identified. Most consequential comparisons include Appraise versus Identify, Cartographer's absolute wording, Deceiver versus truth magic, Forager's guaranteed quantity, Improved Athlete's standing jump, Tracker's proposed exceptional trail sense and Wilderness Walker's terrain breadth. These require affirmative source discussion, not quiet insertion into active rules. All fifty worked cases are authored examples, not executed runtime or campaign facts.

proposals.procedure: Gain Acrobatics proficiency; an existing proficiency supplies no extra grant under the proposed fixed-grant rule. On an actual Athletics check primarily resolving a jump, you may use your Dexterity modifier in place of Strength. NEW: choose the ability before rolling. It remains an Athletics check: apply actual Athletics proficiency or Expertise once, not Acrobatics proficiency merely because Dexterity is used. This substitution changes the check only. Calculate maximum jump distance, approach, movement spent, clearance and landing from the actual movement procedure and other owned features. No automatic success, standing-jump increase, climbing Speed or Acrobatic Mastery reroll is granted.
proposals.newChoices: Pre-roll ability choice and proficiency identity; fixed duplicate-grant policy. Original Dexterity substitution is retained without importing Acrobat's Expertise.
workedCases: DEX +3, STR +1, PB +2 and Athletics proficiency gives +5 on the chosen Dexterity (Athletics) jumping check. Acrobatics Expertise does not raise it to +7.
A legal check using Dexterity still cannot cross a gap beyond the character's actual jump reach or place them in an occupied landing space.

proposals.procedure: Gain advantage on actual Charisma (Deception) or Charisma (Performance) checks whose declared purpose is passing yourself off as a different person. NEW: the identity can be invented or real, but the chosen presentation must be physically possible with your actual appearance, voice, clothing, languages, knowledge and any separately active disguise or magic. Familiarity with a real person's observed traits supplies evidence for imitating those traits; it does not create an automatic perfect voice copy. The Director states what scrutiny the check resolves before rolling. A forged identity does not defeat an independent magical identification effect unless that effect actually calls for the qualifying check. This feat grants no kit, prepared disguise, extra preparation time, memories or understanding of an unlearned language. Disguise Expert's separate flat bonus may coexist only under the final feat-stacking decision; advantage itself never stacks.
proposals.newChoices: Physically plausible invented/real identity and evidence scope; no automatic mimicry grant beyond the source advantage.
workedCases: An actor who speaks the requested language and has observed a guard's manner can gain advantage on the actual Deception check to pass as that guard. The feat does not reveal the guard's private password.
A magical scan that directly reports the subject's actual identity without a Deception/Performance contest is not defeated by rolling with advantage on an unrelated conversation.

proposals.procedure: Spend ten active minutes closely inspecting one actual item with adequate sensory access and tools appropriate to safely examine it. NEW: make Intelligence (Investigation), DC10 for a plainly identifiable mundane object,15 for complex mundane construction,20 for an ordinary magical item, or25 for a unique unfamiliar construction; a specific item's explicit identification DC or concealment exception controls instead. Set the classification and actual information before rolling. On Success or Critical Success, learn its exact current reference value and complete discoverable operative properties, including magical properties and a curse unless that curse's specific source prevents this identification. Reference value means the recorded undamaged catalog price adjusted by the governing condition/valuation rule, or a Director-established local fair-market valuation when no catalog price exists, fixed before the roll. It is not a guaranteed purchase or sale offer. The property result states uses, limits, charges, activation and known operational risks from the actual item's complete record; it does not invent a missing profile, formula, historical truth or cosmology. A source explicitly resisting identification may withhold its protected part while other properties are identified. Safe appraisal is not activation or disarming; actual independent touch/proximity triggers remain. Failure spends time and yields no exact appraisal; another attempt needs changed evidence, access or method. This deliberately preserves a powerful item-identification benefit and requires direct comparison with Identify before adoption.
proposals.newChoices: Time, DC tiers, value definition, magic/curse scope and explicit identification exceptions. Restricting any source's 'any item' promise requires the stated joint decision.
workedCases: A known item with reference value40gp can be appraised at40gp while a real buyer offers only20gp. The feat identifies the reference value; it does not compel that buyer to pay40gp.

An ordinary magical wand's complete operative profile can be learned on the proposed DC20 success. An explicitly identification-proof curse remains protected by its own source; its lore is not invented.
dependencies: Sealed properties remain literal operational boundaries

proposals.procedure: Gain Intimidation proficiency. When making an actual Intimidation check, you may substitute Strength for Charisma. NEW: declare that choice before rolling and describe an actual physically intimidating presentation the target can perceive; false impossible strength or an absent threat does not become evidence from the feat. The check remains Intimidation and uses its applicable proficiency contribution once. Other legal intimidation methods may still use Charisma. This feat changes neither the ordinary social stakes nor the cost of violence, reputation, payment or consent. A successful check does not automatically impose Frightened, Charmed, obedience, a surrendered asset or a condition not included in the declared possible outcome. Commanding Presence remains a distinct source with its own reverse-substitution wording.
proposals.newChoices: Pre-roll declared method and Strength substitution; fixed duplicate-proficiency policy.
workedCases: STR +4, CHA -1 and PB +3 yields +7 for a qualifying Strength (Intimidation) check. Proficiency is not added again because an intimidating weapon is present.
A guard incapable of perceiving the display receives no automatic intimidation consequence. On an actual successful exchange, resolve only the possible concession stated before the roll.

proposals.procedure: Create an accurate record of a route or place you actually observe, using real recording materials. NEW: record one minute of active map work for each distinct junction or approximately100feet of visible route, whichever requires more work; a scale overview from a clear vantage can be recorded in ten minutes. Ordinary mapping is separate work unless another feature, such as Dungeon Cartographer, permits concurrent normal-pace mapping. 'Never get lost' means you retain a reliable account of your own traversed path and current position relative to its still-valid recorded landmarks: you cannot accidentally choose a wrong already-known branch solely through a navigation failure. It does not reveal an unvisited area, locate an unknown destination, connect an unobserved teleportation gap or preserve a physically destroyed route. A changed or illusory landmark may require investigation; the feat preserves what was actually perceived rather than certifying it true. Gain advantage on actual Survival navigation checks, including where incomplete new information still makes the route uncertain. Others using your map receive its actual information, not your personal never-lost guarantee or advantage unless another feature grants it.
proposals.newChoices: Finite mapping times; explicit proposed meaning of 'never get lost'; traversed-route guarantee, changed terrain and user-specific benefit.
workedCases: On an unchanged route the holder already traversed, a failed navigation check cannot make them accidentally take the wrong recorded junction. A missing bridge still requires a real solution.
After an unobserved teleportation, the old map remains accurate where its terrain survives, but the feat supplies no invented connection between departure and arrival.

proposals.procedure: Gain a climbing Speed equal to your current legal walking Speed and advantage on actual Athletics checks made to climb. NEW: derive the speed from the current body and applicable speed penalties, not an unmodified ancestral baseline. Follow the shared spent-movement-cost ledger when switching modes, so movement already spent is never refunded. Climbing still needs support your actual hands, limbs, equipment and surface can provide; the feat does not add adhesion, free hands or a flying mode. A check occurs only when the route calls for one, and advantage does not eliminate its real failure consequence. Grip, slippery material, load, damage, support collapse, zero Speed and falls keep their ordinary rules. A second feature granting the same climb Speed does not add another walking Speed; use the actual applicable movement profile.
proposals.newChoices: Current-speed derivation, real support and nonadditive mode grant. No silent ceiling permission or immunity to falls.
workedCases: Walking Speed20 gives climbing Speed20. With10movement-cost feet already spent, the current20-foot budget leaves10, subject to terrain costs on the climb.
Athletics advantage helps a real slick-wall climb, but a ceiling with no possible grip requires another supported method; owning Climber alone does not create one.

proposals.procedure: When an actual Intimidation task would use Strength, you may use Charisma instead; choose before rolling. Ordinary Charisma (Intimidation) already uses Charisma, so this clause gives no second modifier or bonus there. It does not grant proficiency. On actual Persuasion checks directed at a creature with an explicitly recorded character level lower than your total character level, gain advantage. NEW: compare true character levels, not CR, Hit Dice, faction standing, rank or apparent seniority. A creature with only CR and no character level is not qualified through a fabricated conversion; its Director can supply an actual level only if its real profile legitimately includes one. Check eligibility at the roll, without granting the speaker metagame disclosure of the hidden value. Equal or higher level gives no advantage from this clause. All actual social possibilities, agency and costs remain.
proposals.newChoices: Charisma substitution retained as written; exact level comparison and explicit no CR conversion. This limitation needs joint source agreement.
workedCases: A level8 speaker negotiating with an actual level5 NPC can gain advantage. An NPC listed only as CR5 is not silently treated as level5.
CHA +3 is used once on ordinary Intimidation. The feat does not make the total CHA +3 plus STR +2 or grant an extra +3.
dependencies: Actual NPC profiles and level fields

proposals.procedure: Gain advantage on actual Charisma ability checks when directly interacting with someone who genuinely holds a noble social position recognized by the current community. Preserve the source's breadth: it is not restricted to etiquette checks or friendly nobles. A Charisma attack or saving throw is not an ability check. NEW audience procedure: spend fifteen active minutes preparing and submitting one credible request through an actually accessible official, host or gatekeeper. Gain advantage on a Persuasion check to arrange an audience with an important figure even when that intermediary is not noble. The audience must be possible under the figure's actual schedule, policy and willingness; announce the attainable appointment and any fee, introduction or condition before rolling. Success secures that opportunity on those terms, not immediate entry, a title, waived security or agreement to the later request. A repeated identical petition to the same gatekeeper yields no new roll without a changed circumstance. Required identity, dress and communication remain actual resources.
proposals.newChoices: Recognized noble identity; concrete audience petition time and advantage extension to the gatekeeper. Original all-Charisma-check benefit preserved.
workedCases: A noble's hostile interrogation can still qualify for the feat's advantage on an actual Charisma check made in that interaction; nobility does not guarantee a friendly response.
A successful gatekeeper petition secures the announced appointment tomorrow with its stated fee. It does not place the character in a closed chamber immediately.
dependencies: Current recognized institutions; no new lore

proposals.procedure: Gain Deception proficiency. NEW explicit source exception: you can deliberately speak a false assertion even while a magical effect would otherwise prohibit that assertion solely because it is a lie or require that assertion to be truthful. This is a narrow exception to truth-compulsion, including the lie-prohibition part of Zone of Truth, and must be approved against those exact spell records. You still make any actual save and remain subject to the effect's other clauses. It grants no automatic convincing success: resolve a real Deception check, opposed defense or other social procedure where required. It does not falsify memories, thoughts, directly revealed facts or independently recorded events; confer no blanket immunity to charm, compelled actions or orders; and does not let you avoid an order to speak or move when that obligation is separate from truthfulness. If another effect punishes actual lies, this feat permits the lie but does not negate its punishment. The caster receives only the information their source actually grants; the feat adds neither an automatic warning nor an undetectability guarantee.
proposals.newChoices: Precise truth-compulsion exception and preservation of all independent magical effects; fixed duplicate proficiency. Consequential Zone of Truth comparison required.
workedCases: After failing a Zone of Truth save, the holder can attempt a deliberate verbal lie under this proposed exception. A suspicious listener may still defeat the Deception check.
A spell that directly reveals an actual memory is not changed by the holder speaking falsely. A separate penalty triggered by telling a lie still resolves.
dependencies: Reviewed Zone of Truth and other compulsion cards

proposals.procedure: Gain advantage on actual Perception or Investigation checks whose purpose is detecting a secret door or a trap. Use Perception to notice accessible sensory clues and Investigation to examine and interpret the actual mechanism or evidence, as the task warrants; do not add both skill proficiencies or roll both automatically. NEW: the feat's advantage changes active rolls only. It does not add a passive+5 or create a passive Investigation procedure by itself. Actual light, senses, range, access and search time remain; a completely inaccessible or undetectable feature is not revealed by an uncalled-for roll. Success reveals the detection information defined by that task, not automatic disarming, a save bonus, damage resistance, magical identification or immunity to a trigger encountered while searching. Trap Sense and Observant are separate feats with their own actual passive grants.
proposals.newChoices: Active-roll scope and no generic passive conversion; bounded Perception/Investigation task selection.
workedCases: An actual Investigation search of a suspicious hinge gains advantage. The same check does not disarm a linked trap unless a separate procedure actually does that.
A passive Perception of15 remains15 from this feat alone; there is no invented+5 for advantage. Separately owned Observant would have its own modifier.

proposals.procedure: Gain Performance proficiency. NEW finite work procedure: arrange a real two-hour performance booking with an accessible venue, an actual audience and a willing payer, using the necessary real instrument, props or voice. The default mundane fee for this proposed booking is2sp, quoted and agreed before work; an actual negotiated contract may specify another amount or a performance standard. Complete the two active hours to earn the contractual payment from that payer, minus any actual venue costs. If the contract makes pay contingent on a check, state that DC and failure payment before accepting. During one fifteen-minute audience interaction within that booking, make Charisma (Performance) DC12 to engage attendees; on success one willing attendee offers an actual relevant local event, contact or rumor from their knowledge. Label hearsay and uncertainty; no attendee with relevant information means no invented rumor. The booking can coexist with that expressly allowed conversation, not another work action or rest. Repeating for the same unchanged audience gives no new information roll; a new booking needs real demand and payment. Record spent time, patron and money so no repeated-roll income is created.
proposals.newChoices: Two-hour booking, default2sp fee, fifteen-minute integrated conversation and DC12 information opportunity; actual contract and finite audience requirements.
workedCases: One completed2sp booking with5cp venue costs nets15cp. It consumes two actual hours and the payer's actual2sp, not an unlimited roll reward.
A successful performance for an audience that knows no relevant news creates no hidden fact. A later identical song to those same attendees does not reset their information.

proposals.procedure: NEW finite interpretation of the source guarantee: in an accessible non-desert, non-arctic area that actually contains enough recoverable edible food and potable water, spend one active eight-hour forage Watch to gather the normal daily food and water requirement for yourself and up to six other ordinary Small/Medium people. This feat guarantees that result from qualifying available resources without a separate yield roll; it does not guarantee access through a hazard, remove contamination or defeat a resource-specific harvesting gate. Identify a real foraging area and deplete its recorded stocks. The actual expedition procedure supplies food/water units, body-size requirements, carry weight and Supply conversion; this feat creates no extra abstract Supply. Larger or unusual consumers use their actual greater requirement from the same finite quantity, not seven unlimited creature-day portions. Record one feat forage output per holder per24 elapsed hours, shared across all locations, with the window beginning on completion; a second feat owner can work separately only against remaining real stock and their actual time. Deserts and arctic regions use ordinary foraging. A stripped, sealed or foodless place cannot satisfy the prerequisite, and no water appears because food exists. Preserve, transport and consume the actual output normally.
proposals.newChoices: Eight-hour guaranteed-yield procedure, qualified stock/access boundary, 24-hour output cadence and standard-person quantity. Literal seven-person promise preserved where its actual resources exist; other cases explicitly require conference.
workedCases: An adequately stocked temperate area can provide seven standard person-days of both food and water after the holder's real Watch. The carried water still needs sufficient containers and capacity.
A previously depleted chamber cannot yield another seven person-days. Food present without a potable water source cannot silently fulfill the missing water half.

proposals.procedure: Identify an actual local information-gathering task, its contacts, topic, permitted method, normal active time and real costs before work. Spend half that actor's normal active time, rounded upward once to a whole minute. NEW: absent a more specific procedure, an ordinary round of local inquiries through accessible willing contacts takes two active hours, reduced here to one. The feat does not reduce an appointment's calendar wait, another person's work, mandatory travel, deciphering unknown language, a fixed magical duration or a research procedure that is not gathering local events, people or rumors. Use the ordinary information/social check and result without an extra numerical bonus. Faster acquisition does not make gossip true, complete, public or freely given. Keep actual bribes, admission, obligations and secrecy risks. No retry of unchanged evidence merely because the task was faster; record which contacts actually supplied which claims. Apply the final feat conference's time-reduction stacking rule rather than multiply overlapping discounts silently.
proposals.newChoices: Two-hour fallback task; half-time rounding and boundary between active inquiry and calendar waits; stacking still a joint choice.
workedCases: A declared90-minute local inquiry becomes45active minutes. A separately scheduled meeting tomorrow still occurs tomorrow.
The holder learns a rumor more quickly, but a false rumor remains false and an unwilling contact does not become willing from the time reduction.

proposals.procedure: Requires the actual Athlete feat, ID athlete. Gain climbing and swimming Speeds equal to current legal walking Speed; alternate sources granting those same modes do not add together. Use actual anatomy, support, water conditions, breathing and the spent-cost ledger; neither movement mode permits an impossible surface or cancels hazards. NEW reading of the source's unrestricted long-jump clause: a standing long jump can span up to the current Strength score in feet; a running long jump uses that same base and retains Athlete's separate increase equal to the nonnegative current Strength modifier. For this proposal, a running approach means at least10feet of actual immediately preceding movement on supporting ground. Both the approach and airborne distance spend movement normally. The feat changes horizontal distance, not vertical clearance, a high jump, flight or safe landing. A legal check can still be needed for a hazardous takeoff or landing, and no success creates additional distance. These proposed standing/running distinctions and the10-foot approach need comparison with the complete movement source review before adoption.
proposals.newChoices: Standing full-Strength distance; explicit10-foot running approach; preserve Athlete's separate running modifier once with nonnegative gain; current-speed grants.
workedCases: STR16 and its+3 modifier permit a proposed16-foot standing jump or19-foot running jump. A10-foot approach plus19feet airborne spends29feet before any additional terrain costs.
Walking Speed0 gives climbing and swimming Speed0. A legal destination still cannot be reached by claiming the jump as free movement.

proposals.procedure: Requires the actual Climber feat, ID climber. NEW: ceiling and overhang climbing is possible with actual usable grips, anchors or equipment sufficient for the current body's support; the feat removes the angle-only bar but supplies no adhesion to a featureless unsupported surface. Pay the ordinary climbing movement budget and make any real required check, including Climber's advantage when applicable. If that climb check fails by a final numerical deficit of1–4, you avoid the fall caused by that failed check. Remain at the last legally supported position, spend the movement/action/time already committed, and gain no progress through the failed segment. A natural-1 degree downgrade with deficit below5 still receives this narrow fall protection. A failed result with total meeting the DC due solely to a natural downgrade also avoids that check's fall under this NEW clarification. Deficit5+ receives no protection. The feat does not stop an unrelated shove, lost anchor, collapsing support, already ongoing fall or deliberate release. A retry needs a legally available new attempt under the climb task, without refunded movement.
proposals.newChoices: Real support versus adhesion; exact failure-margin/zero-deficit handling; position and spent-cost consequence.
workedCases: DC18, total14 fails by4: remain at the last supported place without gaining the failed traverse, and keep the spent movement cost. Total13 fails by5 and may fall normally.
A rope anchor breaks after a successful climb. That is a separate loss of support, so the feat's failed-check protection does not suspend the climber in air.

proposals.procedure: Always know the direction designated as true north in the current region's established physical/map frame and the remaining elapsed hours to its actual next sunrise or sunset when that event exists. This requires no artificial navigation roll, but does not reveal passages, destinations or a safe route. NEW boundary: where no such direction/event is defined by actual setting evidence, record 'not defined here' or 'no scheduled event' rather than inventing a cosmological answer; confer on any real exception later. Accurately recall anything you actually perceived by sight or hearing within the past month, including sounds or marks you did not understand, without thereby translating them or learning concealed details. NEW: for this feat's memory window only, month means30elapsed24-hour days; this does not define the world's calendar. Recollection can reproduce the perceived sequence, but limited attention, obstructed senses and a deceptive illusion limit what was perceived. Explicit memory alteration follows its own effect. Numerical dawn-like recharge receipts are not evidence of sunrise. No soul, plane, alignment or celestial explanation is authored here.
proposals.newChoices: Defined-frame/no-event boundary;30-day memory window and perception-versus-truth distinction. No new astronomical canon.
workedCases: A rune seen clearly ten days ago can be recalled in its observed form, but an unread language remains untranslated. A hidden reverse side was never seen.
A place with no actual sunrise schedule receives no invented time-to-sunrise. An item that recharges at06:00 does not establish a sunrise at06:00.

proposals.procedure: NEW finite recruitment/loyalty procedure: during a real recruitment effort, designate up to current PB actual willing prospective followers or hirelings. Spend one active hour interviewing and briefing them, agree on their actual jobs, pay, duration, risk, equipment and departure terms, and gain+2 on any legitimate Persuasion checks to secure those agreements. An automatic willing agreement needs no roll. The feat creates no candidate, free wage, stat block, level, binding, summoned unit or extra class companion. Keep at most PB current designated contracts receiving the feat's loyalty benefit; designate at agreement or at a new hour-long briefing, never retroactively during a morale event. While the employer honors the terms and the work remains within the agreed risk, a designated follower gains+2 on an actual loyalty/morale check whose purpose is deciding whether to abandon that agreement under pressure. This is not a bonus against every fear spell or a compulsion to stay; no roll is invented where the person's real decision is certain. Broken terms, unpaid wages or an unagreed suicidal demand remove this benefit until genuinely repaired and re-briefed. Actual transport, expedition caps, combat turns and command budgets continue to govern each recruited person. Dismissal ends designation without transferring any creature's property or earned wages.
proposals.newChoices: PB designated-contract cap, one-hour briefing, +2 recruitment and scoped+2 loyalty checks; contract/agency bounds. Requires final hireling procedure.
workedCases: PB3 can designate three real hired people, each still requiring a valid contract and actual pay. The feat does not authorize a thirteenth expedition character against the owner's12-character cap.
A follower ordered into danger expressly excluded from their contract does not receive a loyalty check that forces compliance. The employer must negotiate a real change or accept refusal.

proposals.procedure: Gain advantage on actual Persuasion checks during negotiations for real goods or services. NEW: before the check, establish the seller/buyer's available stock, normal quote, attainable concession, payment and conditions. A successful check secures that announced better quote or term; no universal percentage discount or guaranteed buyer is created. A concession can be a lower price, improved payment schedule, delivery, included fitting or a better actual sale offer, with its exact value set before rolling. The counterpart must have authority and willingness to consider it. Failed unchanged negotiations cannot be repeated by restating the same bargain or swapping speakers without a materially changed offer or evidence. Distinct standing, sponsor and service benefits use their own actual clauses; advantage does not stack. Different purchase and resale quotes remain separate, and this feat never establishes a same-price repurchase promise or circular money source. Record the final agreement and any taxes/fees through the actual settlement procedure.
proposals.newChoices: Predeclared exact concession and finite bargain record; no invented blanket percentage. Full live market/social procedure supplies numeric quote limits.
workedCases: A merchant offers a possible reduction from50gp to45gp on success. A successful advantaged check secures45gp under the announced terms; it does not also apply another unprinted10% discount.
Buying for45gp does not force any buyer to repurchase for50gp. A later actual resale uses that buyer's own stock, demand and quote.

proposals.procedure: At acquisition choose Intelligence or Wisdom and increase that score by1, to the ordinary maximum20 unless a separately reviewed source explicitly permits more. Gain+5 to passive Perception and passive Investigation. NEW: passive Perception is10 plus the current Wisdom (Perception) modifier including applicable proficiency once; passive Investigation is10 plus the current Intelligence (Investigation) modifier including applicable proficiency once. Apply this feat's+5 once to each. Passive Investigation may resolve a declared sustained or routine examination of actually accessible physical evidence when the governing task permits a passive result; it is not a free constant scan for every hidden detail. Specific tasks requiring an active check or paid examination remain active. No natural-die shift or automatic passive±5 for advantage/disadvantage is added. Apply actual qualifying numerical penalties or bonuses in their normal scope. This feat gives no+5 to active rolls, attack detection through impossible senses or automatic truth about an illusion. The score increase can independently alter its own relevant ability modifiers.
proposals.newChoices: Score cap and declared passive-Investigation procedure; actual formulas; no generic advantage conversion.
workedCases: WIS16 and Perception proficiency at PB+2 gives passive Perception10+3+2+5=20. An active Perception roll gets the ordinary+5 modifier, not an additional feat+5.
INT15 increased to16 with Investigation proficiency at PB+3 gives passive Investigation10+3+3+5=21 when that passive task is allowed. A required lock examination still takes its stated time.

proposals.procedure: While you actively lead one physically coordinated traveling party, the party may track at its actual normal travel pace and ignore ordinary difficult terrain's reduction of strategic travel rate. NEW: party members must remain on the led route and able to follow your current directions directly or through their actual communications chain; separated scouts and a different caravan receive no remote benefit. Use the normal rate of the actual slowest participating body/vehicle, with actual capacity, access and work/rest limits. A mount or wagon can benefit only on a route it can physically traverse; the feat supplies neither a road through an impassable gap nor a swim/fly/climb mode. Severe weather, visibility, moving currents, climbing tasks, hazards, loading and other independent delays still apply. This changes the difficult-terrain travel-rate factor and tracking activity, not tactical difficult-terrain movement costs, combat Speed, forced-march rules or resource consumption. If leadership/coordination ends, subsequent travel uses ordinary rates; already elapsed time is not recalculated.
proposals.newChoices: One coordinated party, strategic-only terrain-rate scope, actual slowest traveler and vehicle legality. Full travel numbers come from the live expedition verdict.
workedCases: A coordinated party with a slower laden wagon uses that wagon's actual normal route rate while ignoring the ordinary rough-ground slowdown. The feat cannot make the wagon cross a path narrower than its body.
A scout who leaves the coordinated route loses the group benefit for their separate travel. During combat, ordinary difficult-terrain costs still apply.

proposals.procedure: Gain proficiency in Survival and Nature. Existing proficiency gives no Expertise under the proposed fixed-grant rule. You may attempt to Hide while only lightly obscured by actual natural phenomena, such as naturally occurring foliage, rainfall, falling snow, fog or blowing dust that genuinely interferes with the observer's view. NEW: this is an express eligibility exception to the ordinary clear-sight bar only while that qualifying partial obscurity exists; it permits a real Hide attempt against each affected observer, not automatic Hidden. Use normal Stealth, observer-specific passive DC, sound, other senses and revealing-event rules. A fully clear view or an observer unaffected by that natural obscurity gains no new bar to seeing you. Ordinary darkness and magical concealment use their own source permissions; merely naming a magical effect 'natural' does not qualify it here. The feat grants no Ranger class level, spells, companion, tracking expertise or movement benefit.
proposals.newChoices: Observed natural obscurity examples; precise Hide eligibility exception; independent observer/sense rules.
workedCases: Actual rain lightly obscures a character from one observer, permitting a Hide attempt. The character still rolls Stealth and can fail to become Hidden from that observer.
A creature using an unaffected sense or a clear angle does not lose the character's position solely because another observer's view is obscured.

proposals.procedure: NEW finite search procedure: choose an accessible previously occupied site and spend thirty active minutes searching one bounded area, such as a room, wreck compartment or campsite. Before the roll the Director records the actual recoverable mundane equipment/supplies, their condition, ownership and access barriers. Make Intelligence (Investigation), DC12 for ordinary scattered remains,15 for concealed useful pieces or20 for heavily obscured remains; a specific site DC takes precedence. On success identify up to1d4 actual item lots from that finite inventory, with a combined reference value at most10gp and combined cargo at most1Load. The die cannot create missing lots: take no more than actually exist and are within those limits. The player chooses which identified lots to retrieve, paying any separate safe-access/removal time; uncollected objects remain in place. These are ordinary catalog-compatible items or usable supplies, not magic loot, a free recipe ingredient classification or converted gp-to-Supply. A larger valuable object can be noticed by the normal search result but is not granted as an extra feat output. Mark searched evidence and removed quantities; another unchanged search of the same area gives no fresh roll or generated inventory. Genuine new access, deposited material or a different bounded area can justify a new attempt.
proposals.newChoices: Thirty-minute task, DC tiers, finite1d4/10gp/1Load discovery cap and site depletion. These numerical bounds need explicit source agreement.
workedCases: The die gives4 but the site holds only two eligible real lots worth7gp and0.5Load: only those two can be recovered. No third or fourth lot appears.
A found locked chest still requires opening and ownership consequences. Repeating the scavenging roll cannot turn its unknown contents into free mundane supplies.
dependencies: Equipment catalog and actual item condition

proposals.procedure: Consume half your actual normal food requirement and half your actual normal potable-water requirement under the governing body/environment schedule. Keep the two quantities separate and exact; purchase indivisible containers or portions as needed but retain unused contents rather than rounding each consumption upward. NEW: choose the strongest applicable fractional requirement reduction instead of multiplying overlapping reductions. This does not erase existing deprivation or replace required breathing, shelter, equipment or rest. To complete the source's broad survival/help clause, NEW proposal: you have advantage on actual Survival checks to adapt a camp, clothing, route or shelter to an ordinary nonmagical environment and on Constitution saves caused solely by ordinary heat/cold exposure. During one active hour preparing a camp or travel plan, you can designate up to PB actual companions participating in that preparation; while they follow the plan and keep its required gear, they share the heat/cold-save advantage for the next eight elapsed hours. This does not confer food/water reduction on them, make unsafe material edible, or permit survival in lava, vacuum, drowning, magical extremes or an environment with no physically possible protective method. Actual hazard frequency, severity, DC and finite protection still apply. These explicit environmental limits are proposed replacements for the source's undefined absolute phrase, not a claim that it already said them.
proposals.newChoices: Exact half quantities; strongest requirement reduction; new Survival/heat-cold advantage and PB companion preparation; explicit scope of 'any environment'.
workedCases: A body needing2food units and4water units for the period consumes1food and2water with this feat; a separate half-requirement effect does not silently make either requirement one quarter.
PB3 permits three actual prepared companions to share the proposed heat/cold advantage for eight hours. They still need their normal water, and none gains the ability to breathe underwater.

proposals.procedure: The source expressly allows tracking over water and air. NEW proposed completion preserves a real exceptional benefit: from an actual known starting trail or witnessed passage, you can perceive faint physical-passage impressions of that same creature's continuous route within60feet of your position for up to24elapsed hours after passage, including its waterborne or airborne segments. This is a feat-local extraordinary trail sense, not free knowledge of every nearby creature. Spend one active minute examining a segment and make Wisdom (Survival) DC15, increased by5 when the trail is more than12hours old and by5 where multiple actual trails are heavily intermingled; an exact concealing source may expressly block or modify this sensing. On success follow the actual local direction and learn the passage's approximate age, creature size and evident physical condition such as limping or bleeding. No exact current HP, identity, destination, invisible present location, future path or unobserved intent is revealed. You still need a physically possible way to traverse the route, time at your legal tracking pace and a new real examination when a junction or lost segment creates uncertainty. Teleportation supplies no traversed intervening path; track ends at departure and resumes only after separately finding the arrival trail. No new plane/soul/cosmological mechanism is inferred. Failed unchanged examination cannot be rerolled without changed access, evidence or method. This exceptional-sense choice needs explicit GPT review against mundane tracking and divination.
proposals.newChoices: Entire exceptional trail-sense procedure,60feet/24hours/one-minute/DC bounds and teleport gap. It deliberately retains water/air tracking rather than making the source clause ineffective.
workedCases: At a witnessed flight departure ten hours ago, a nearby actual airborne trail can be followed on the proposed DC15 success. The tracker still needs a real route or flight capability to follow it vertically.
A sixteen-hour-old heavily intermingled trail uses proposed DC25. A teleport at its end gives no directional line to the arrival point; no intervening travel happened.
dependencies: Actual creature paths; no cosmology interpretation

proposals.procedure: Use the shared Skill-feat proposal's explicit acquisition bridge for Survival4+: actual Survival proficiency and permanent ordinary skill modifier at least+4, excluding temporary/situational bonuses. NEW broad completion of 'no movement penalty in terrain': when your own body moves through an actually traversable route, ignore extra movement-cost factors and Speed reductions whose sole stated cause is the terrain itself, including ordinary difficult/severe ground and magical terrain that only imposes those movement penalties. Crawling, squeezing, load, injury, creature conditions, lack of a movement mode, occupied-space restrictions, forced movement and an actual obstruction remain separate causes and still apply. A terrain hazard's attack, save, damage, falling risk or inflicted Grappled/Restrained condition is not itself waived; if its separate condition reduces Speed, that condition remains. In strategic travel remove only your own terrain-derived rate penalty, not every party member's; the group still uses its actual slowest participant. A mount, vehicle or carried companion does not inherit your feat. Mode switching retains spent movement costs and never refunds earlier expenditure. This deliberately proposes broad terrain-cost protection, including qualifying magical terrain, and needs exact spell/hazard comparisons rather than silently narrowing the source to woodland alone.
proposals.newChoices: Numeric prerequisite bridge; explicit terrain-only cause arbitration; magical terrain included, independent costs/conditions excluded; personal strategic scope.
workedCases: Crawling and squeezing through difficult terrain normally costs4feet per foot under current Core. Removing the terrain surcharge leaves3feet per foot: base1, crawling1 and squeezing1.
A magical bog that only doubles terrain movement cost can be crossed at ordinary terrain cost. If its separate failed save inflicts Restrained, the resulting Speed0 remains until that condition ends.
